posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: Opening post. They want a work bag that fits A4 notebooks, has a separate pocket for keys and phone, a shoulder strap plus shorter handles, and looks smart but not like a work bag so it works at weekends. Like Marc Jacobs totes but many colleagues have them. Budget about £150-£200; open to tan, black or bright colours.
posts.quote: I'm looking for a new work bag.

posts.author: Ozanj
posts.paraphrase: They use a large Kate Spade Bleecker tote as their work bag so they do not have to carry two bags; it holds two laptops, peripherals, a wristlet, makeup and a spare pair of shoes.
posts.quote: I use the Kate Spade Bleeker large tote as my work bag as I hate carrying two.

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They thank Ozanj, like the colour options and note the Kate Spade bag is on sale.
posts.quote: it's on sale at the moment

posts.author: Postslikethese
posts.paraphrase: They recommend the Meg & Bee leather tote, which has lasted two years of daily use; praise the leather quality and suggest buying long straps from the brand or Amazon to match outfits (linked).

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They say they love the detail on the Longchamp bag.
posts.quote: I love the detail on that.

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They had forgotten Longchamp; a former colleague had one and loved it.
posts.quote: someone I used to work with had one, and loved it.

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They heard their local Ted Baker is closing that week and may check it for bags; disappointed because they like the brand.
posts.quote: I've just heard our local Ted Baker is closing down later this week

posts.author: Talipesmum
posts.paraphrase: They have owned a dark brown vintage-style 3-way leather tote (Amazon, S-Zone, size L) for three years and it still looks perfect; say the low price does not mean poor quality (linked).
posts.quote: I've had this one for 3 years now and it still looks perfect.

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They ask how it is so cheap and whether it has the chemical leather smell common to cheaper leathers and Amazon products.
posts.quote: Does it have that weird leather smell though

posts.author: Talipesmum
posts.paraphrase: They say there is no smell; the lower price is partly due to the lining design leaving a loose extra side pocket. The bag fits a laptop, A4 notebook, headphones, cable, keys and phone, holds its shape, and is real leather with a smart finish.
posts.quote: it's definitely real leather with a nice smart finish

posts.author: Fathomless
posts.paraphrase: They recommend the White Stuff Hannah leather tote in mid tan (also navy), which they have wanted for a while (linked).
posts.quote: I've coveted this for a while.

posts.author: ShouldIStaySelfIsolated
posts.paraphrase: They say they love the Hannah tote.

posts.author: ValsCupcakes
posts.paraphrase: They ask whether the Hannah tote is not leather.
posts.quote: They're not leather though, are they?

posts.author: sweetpickle2
posts.paraphrase: They say the retailer lists the Hannah tote as Saffiano leather and question whether the OP said it needed to be leather.
posts.quote: where has the OP said it needs to be leather?

posts.author: ValsCupcakes
posts.paraphrase: They say the OP did not require leather but they personally want it; share an eBay listing for a Kate Spade Bleecker tote described as PVC, not leather.
posts.quote: This tote bag features a solid black exterior made of durable PVC material

posts.author: sweetpickle2
posts.paraphrase: They say the Kate Spade website lists the zip-top version as leather; recommend trusting the official site over a random eBay listing and link the non-zip large tote.
posts.quote: I'd get my intel from the kate spade website over a random ebay listing personally
